target_customer: Retail investors who want AI research on their own brokerage portfolio
problem: Everyday investors lack time and tools to track news, filings and risk across their holdings. Ekpa connects read-only to brokerage accounts and runs AI research and simulations.
business_model: Free during early access; future monetization not stated
product_category: AI portfolio research app for retail investors

founders.name: Anant Asthana
education: MIT, CS and ChemE (per YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: Launch post says he built agentic pipelines for drug discovery.

founders.name: Yuga Patel
education: MIT, CS and Economics (per YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: Launch post cites investment experience without naming employers.

competitors.name: Public.com AI investing agents
competitors.what: AI agents that monitor markets and execute trades from plain language instructions

competitors.name: Edgen
competitors.what: Always-on AI CIO giving proactive insights to retail investors

technical_complexity.rationale: A research chat and portfolio analytics layer on top of public LLMs and a brokerage aggregation API (SnapTrade) is standard engineering. Reliable financial analysis is the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Well-funded brokerages and AI finance tools offered similar agents in the same months, and nothing proprietary is evidenced.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were shipping retail AI research and agents in 2026 before or alongside Ekpa's batch.

market_need_then: Retail interest in AI research tools was visible in 2026 launches by several players. The company claims 6,500+ analyses run and $7M+ in connected assets, which are unverified self-reported figures.

branding.domain_note: Uses goekpa.com, a go prefix on the name

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain product voice aimed at everyday traders

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand; name searches return unrelated results.

outcome_analysis: Ekpa is an early Summer 2026 company with no outcome yet. Two MIT student founders launched a free AI portfolio research app into a space where brokerages and AI finance firms were shipping similar agents. The only public signals are the YC listing and self-reported usage numbers, so its trajectory is unknown.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125k seed with no investor; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round, and Dealroom's profile describes the product differently and gives a San Francisco location. Site says only Backed by Y Combinator. Performance claims on the launch post are unverified. Completeness pass: the 125K seed is now recorded from Dealroom alone (single database, no date, investors hidden behind a paywall; the profile is labeled as AI made). Cross-check search found no other source.
